_comment: Hand-established ground truth for tools/catalog-recall.js. NOT generated.
Each entry was built by reading the lab's README for what it claims to implement and
then confirming each claim against the lab's own source, in whatever language that
source is written in. It is deliberately NOT built from the scanner's output, which
is the thing being measured: ground truth derived from the tool under test measures
`implements` is the in-vocabulary truth: algorithms the lab computes that a term in
catalog-vocab.js could match. Recall is measured against this and nothing else.
`outOfVocabulary` is the lab's other implemented algorithms, for which no term
exists. These are NOT recall failures - the scanner cannot be blamed for missing a
term nobody wrote - but they are the vocabulary's coverage debt, counted separately
so the two failures never get averaged into one comfortable number.
method: Stratified by implementation style, taken from the fleet in sorted order at fixed intervals within each stratum so the choice is reproducible rather than convenient: 3 WebCrypto (of 92), 3 @noble (46), 3 hand-rolled (44), 2 UNKNOWN (14), 1 partially-unread (9). The two NOT-SCANNED labs are excluded by construction - there is no finding to measure.

crypto-lab-aegis-gate.how: aegis256Encrypt/Decrypt and aesRound/SBOX in src/; benchmarkAesGcm calls WebCrypto AES-GCM.

crypto-lab-hpke-envelope.how: src/hpke/{dhkem,aead,context}.ts compose DHKEM(X25519,HKDF-SHA256) with AES-128-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305; both AEADs present in src/hpke/aead.ts.

crypto-lab-pq-families.how: src/crypto.ts exports lamportKeygen and digestMessage; the rest of the lab is a landscape map, not implementations.

crypto-lab-accumulator.how: RSA-group accumulate/absenceProof over an RSA modulus; SHA-256 via @noble/hashes/sha256. Judgement recorded: it computes in an RSA group and implements no RSA encryption or signature.

crypto-lab-frozen-heart.how: src/schnorr/group.ts imports RistrettoPoint and ed25519 from @noble/curves; fiatshamir.ts computes the challenge; sha512 from @noble/hashes.

crypto-lab-pake-gate.how: src/pake/factories.ts builds SRP-6a, J-PAKE, CPace and Dragonfly by hand; src/pake/hashes.ts derives with HKDF. Three of the four PAKEs have no vocabulary term.

crypto-lab-blind-hello.how: buildClientHello/decodeClientHelloInner construct and parse real TLS 1.3 ClientHello structures with ECH extensions.

crypto-lab-fte.how: aesCtrEncrypt/aesCtrDecrypt in src/; the regex-ranked DFA machinery is the lab's own subject and has no term.

crypto-lab-ntru-classic.how: generateKeyPair/encrypt/decrypt over the 1996 HPS parameter set, with centerMod and ternary polynomial arithmetic.

crypto-lab-biham-lens.how: Differential cryptanalysis against a toy SPN built for the lesson. No standard algorithm is computed, so UNKNOWN is the correct finding rather than a miss.

crypto-lab-hqc-timing-break.how: runAttack/llr simulate a cache-timing oracle; the README states a repetition code stands in for HQC's Reed-Muller inner code. Implements neither HQC nor Reed-Muller, so UNKNOWN is correct.

crypto-lab-context-ward.how: src/primitives.ts exports sha256, hmacSha256, hkdfSha256, ed25519Sign/Verify. One Python file in the repo is not read by the scanner.
